notes: One logical two-leg monthly gold/silver relative median-seasonality package. Q02 evaluates combined package PnL, paired costs, activity, and later Q09 correlation; neither component leg is a standalone strategy.

For the upcoming calendar month, the EA scans exact years Y-1 through Y-10, requires at least five synchronized XAU-minus-XAG log returns, computes the ordinary odd/even sample median, and follows its sign only when it lies strictly outside plus or minus 1e-12.

The package splits one RISK_FIXED budget equally by frozen per-leg ATR stop risk and follows the validated QM5_12533 logical-basket host-symbol recipe with USD tester currency and the canonical 100000 deposit.
